function.name: search_anime
function.description: Search for anime by name. Use this when the user wants to find an anime, subscribe to an anime, or when an anime ID is needed for another tool. Never guess an anime ID.

query.description: The anime name or search query provided by the user.

function.name: subscribe
function.description: Subscribe the current user to a specific anime. Use this only after exactly one anime has been identified. The anime_id must come directly from a previous search_anime result.

anime_id.description: The exact anime ID selected from a previous search_anime result.

function.name: getNextEpisodeDetails
function.description: Get the next upcoming subtitled episode of a specific anime, including the episode number and its release date and time. Use this when the user asks what episode is coming next, when the next episode will air, or when the next episode is releasing. The anime_id must come directly from a previous search_anime result.

anime_id.description: The exact anime ID from a previous search_anime result.

function.name: getAiringAnime
function.description: Get subtitled anime episodes airing on a specific calendar day. Use this when the user asks what anime is airing today, tomorrow, the day after tomorrow, or on a day within the next 2 days. Interpret relative dates using India Standard Time (IST). Set day_offset to 0 for today, 1 for tomorrow, and 2 for the day after tomorrow. This tool filters results to only the requested date. Do not use this tool for dates outside this range.

day_offset.description: Number of calendar days from today in IST: 0 = today, 1 = tomorrow, 2 = the day after tomorrow.

function.name: getAnimeDetails
function.description: Get detailed information about a specific anime, including its synopsis, genres, episode count, and airing status. Use this when the user asks what an anime is about or asks for more information about an anime.
